# PyMongoArrow - (current)

> Explore PyMongoArrow, a PyMongo extension for loading MongoDB query results as Apache Arrow tables, NumPy arrays, and Pandas or Polars DataFrames.

- [Data Types](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/data-types.md): Explore the supported BSON data types, including embedded arrays and documents, and learn about type identifiers and extension types for Arrow and Pandas.
- [Get Started with PyMongoArrow](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/get-started.md): Explore how to install PyMongoArrow and use it for data manipulation in MongoDB, including inserting, querying, and writing query results to Parquet and CSV.
- [MongoDB PyMongoArrow](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/index.md): Explore PyMongoArrow, a PyMongo extension for loading MongoDB query results as Apache Arrow tables, NumPy arrays, and Pandas or Polars DataFrames.
- [Issues & Help](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/issues-and-help.md): Find support for PyMongoArrow through community forums, report bugs or request features via JIRA, and contribute to the library with pull requests.
- [Reference](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/reference.md)
- [Compare PyMongoArrow to PyMongo](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/reference/comparison.md): Compare the differences between PyMongoArrow and PyMongo, focusing on data reading and writing, BSON type support, and performance benchmarks.
- [Documentation for Versions 0.4 to 1.2](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/reference/previous-versions.md): Access documentation for previous versions of PyMongoArrow, including versions 1.2, 1.1, and 1.0.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/reference/release-notes.md): Discover the latest updates in PyMongoArrow, including new features, bug fixes, breaking changes, and dependency compatibility updates for each release.
- [Schema Examples](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-arrow-driver/current/schemas.md): Explore how to use PyMongoArrow schemas for handling nested data and projections in MongoDB operations with Python.
